entries.title: A smarter, clearer WEdit newsroom
notes: Redesigned the announcement reader with unread counts, local read status, search, and clear live/offline states.
Added per-post mark-read, copy, and details actions plus a calmer empty state.
Added public newsroom search, sort, refresh feedback, and a live announcement preview for publishers.

entries.title: Profile sync, animated themes, and custom sounds
notes: Home can read your visible WhatsApp name, About text, phone, and profile photo.
Added custom interface sounds, opening animations, a separate update welcome, and decorative borders.
Theme JSON now includes animation, frame, and chain-motion settings.

entries.title: Home dashboard, profile shortcuts, and movable launcher
notes: Added a home dashboard with local profile card, shortcuts, release notes, and announcements.
Added more built-in palettes and kept custom theme import/export.
Made the WEdit launcher draggable and remembered its position on this device.

entries.title: Quick hide, clean updates, announcements site
notes: Added Quick hide (Alt+Shift+H) to restore original message text and hide WEdit controls.
Update checks show an in-page notice with an explicit Tampermonkey update action.
Added a Vercel announcements site with a server-side publisher.

entries.title: Keyed announcement publishing
notes: Added an initial announcement publishing scaffold; the deployed publishing site arrived in 4.0.0.

entries.title: Faster Tampermonkey update notices
notes: WEdit checks the published userscript version when WhatsApp Web loads and offers an update button.

entries.title: Better editing, announcements, and stickers
notes: Added a live text preview, character count, and reset-to-original draft control.
Added a guided announcement composer and reusable local sticker shelf.

entries.title: Announcements and sound
notes: Added public announcements, optional local interface sounds, and an in-panel changelog.

entries.title: Tampermonkey updates
notes: Added GitHub update metadata for the Tampermonkey userscript.
